full_prompt_en: A square digital painterly portrait fills the frame with the face of a dark-haired young woman against a fractured teal and charcoal background. She looks almost straight toward the viewer, with green-brown eyes, a calm mouth and a slight turn toward the right. Loose black strands cross her forehead and cheek, while the rest of her hair gathers into a dark mass along the upper edge. Small bright fragments near the upper right of the hair catch cool white and violet light. Her face is the clearest part of the image: warm peach planes model the cheek and brow, a slim white highlight runs along the nose, and muted coral color rests on the lips. Below the chin, only a small area of clothing is visible, in deep burgundy, burnt orange and yellow-green patterned accents. Around the face, the paint breaks into angular teal-gray patches, dark smears, slender scratches and a few hot orange marks. Those rough peripheral strokes contrast with the smooth, almost luminous facial rendering. The background stays shallow and abstract; it carries no legible place, objects or text. Light appears to come from the front-left and upper right in small glancing hits, leaving the far side of the hair nearly black and the face softly modeled. Fine hairline marks and scraped color sit on top of broad digital brush areas, giving the image both precision and improvisation. The overall composition is intense but restrained, with a sharply focused face held amid turbulent cool color and sparse warm sparks.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形数字绘画式肖像让一名深发年轻女子的脸几乎填满画面，背后是破碎的青蓝与炭黑色背景。她几乎正视观者，绿棕色眼睛、平静的嘴和略向右转的头部十分清楚。松散黑发横过额头与脸颊，其余头发在上缘聚成深色块。头发右上附近几块明亮碎片接住冷白与紫色光。面部是画中最清晰之处：暖桃色色面塑出脸颊与眉弓，一道细白高光沿鼻梁下行，低调珊瑚色停在嘴唇上。下巴下只露出少量衣服，有深酒红、焦橙和黄绿色花纹重音。脸部周围，颜料散成有角度的青灰碎块、深色擦痕、细长划线和几笔灼热橙色。粗糙边缘笔痕与平滑、近乎发光的面部渲染形成对比。背景浅而抽象，没有可识别地点、物件或文字。光仿佛从左前方和右上方以少量斜掠亮点照来，让头发远侧近黑，面部则柔和塑形。发丝般细线与刮擦色彩覆盖在宽阔数字画笔区域上，使画面兼有精确与即兴。整体构图强烈但克制，一张焦点清楚的脸被动荡的冷色和少量暖色火花环绕。
style_prompt_en: A contemporary digital-painting treatment contrasts smooth luminous modeling with aggressively broken peripheral brushwork. Warm peach and coral values gather in a small focal zone; teal, slate gray, violet-black and scattered orange marks fracture the surrounding field. Edges sharpen where attention concentrates, then split into angular patches, long scratches and translucent smears toward the margins. Very fine linear detail overlays broad painterly blocks, creating a surface that feels simultaneously polished and worked over. Glancing cool highlights and selective warm reflected color provide depth without a fully specified environment. The framing is close and asymmetrical, with a calm bright core held against energetic dark texture. The result is vivid, cinematic and emotionally immediate.
style_prompt_zh: 当代数字绘画处理让平滑发亮的塑形与猛烈破碎的外围笔触对照。暖桃与珊瑚色明度聚在小范围焦点区；青蓝、板岩灰、紫黑和零散橙色笔痕使周围色域碎裂。注意力集中的地方边缘变锐，向画边则分裂为角状色块、长划痕与透明擦涂。极细线性细节覆盖宽阔绘画性色块，让表面同时显得精致且反复加工。斜掠的冷高光与选择性暖反光提供纵深，却不明确交代环境。贴近而不对称的框景把平静明亮的核心置于活跃暗色肌理前。整体鲜明、有电影感且情绪直接。
theme_en: A close portrait of a dark-haired woman against fractured teal and amber paint
theme_zh: 深发女子贴近镜头，身后是破碎青蓝与琥珀色笔触
name: Yanjun Cheng
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
